isolation.evidence: Fresh general-purpose subagent dispatched with only the frozen prompt.md text plus the output path; no coordinator conversation or sibling outputs passed in.

limitations: User-level Claude Code configuration leaked into the worker context: the output contains a `ponytail:` comment from the contributor's minimalism-focused user config, confirming the environment was not fully clean.
Worker had filesystem access to the repository (output path is inside the repo tree), so sibling outputs were reachable even though none were passed in.
Output requires network access to the Three.js CDN at load time.
